claims.evidence: Raw headers of mtob1_f001.raw, mtob2_f160.raw and plaque_f080.raw read 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'; Methods: 'Q-Exactive HF Orbitrap MS'; PRIDE instruments MS:1002523. OLS label 'Q Exactive HF'.

Methods: '~50 ug protein from each sample was then digested in two steps by Lys-C and trypsin'; pepXML sample_enzyme 'tryptic' cut=KR no_cut=P. Lys-C listed first (first step). MS:1001309 Lys-C and MS:1001251 Trypsin verified in OLS.
Methods: '20 data-dependent MS2 scans'; PRIDE protocol: 'up to 20 datadependent high-resolution MS/MS scans'.
Methods MS2 settings: 'HCD, 32% specified normalized collision energy'. MS:1000422 = HCD (OLS label 'beam-type collision-induced dissociation').
Methods: 'HCD, 32% specified normalized collision energy'.
Methods: 'fractionated by offline basic reverse phase (RP) LC ... pH 8.0'; PRIDE protocol: 'fractionated ... under basic pH conditions'.
Methods: MS2 at '60,000 resolutions' on the Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (MS2 read in the Orbitrap).
Released ms-proteomics template version in the spec templates.yaml (1.1.0); build pinned with -t ms-proteomics@1.1.0.
Templates chosen: MS proteomics; mouse -> vertebrates; clinical-metadata licenses characteristics[genotype] (and exposure duration). Filled by sdrf-tools build.
Annotation produced by curation from the sources listed (sdrf-tools build expander).
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; Methods: 5xFAD and WT mice. NCBITaxon:10090 'Mus musculus'.
Sample sheet ages: 8-9 months (turnover), 3, 8, 12 months (plaque) - all post-weaning adult mice. EFO:0001272 'adult'. INFERRED from age.
Replicate index per (genotype, condition) group taken from the sample-ID suffix in PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx.
Every vendor .raw listed in files/all for this sub-experiment; one file per fraction.
File stem of the raw file; shared by the 16 TMT channel rows of each run.
TMT-LC/LC-MS/MS; filled by sdrf-tools build from ms-proteomics.
Each TMT batch was fractionated and injected once per fraction; no repeated injections.
TMTpro 16-plex channel per sample from the 'TMTpro channel' column; PRIDE protocol '16-plex tandem-mass-tag (TMT) labeling'.
Position of the run in the f001..fNNN series; sheet: 'Number of fractions in each batch: 160' (turnover) / 80 (plaque).
'Genotype' column (WT / 5xFAD) per sample ID; Supplementary Data 2 agrees for the 30 turnover mice.
Genotype (WT vs 5xFAD) is the compared variable (two-way ANOVA genotype x labelling time; plaque study 5xFAD vs WT).
5xFAD = familial AD amyloidosis model (Methods); WT littermates are controls -> normal (PATO:0000461); MONDO:0004975 'Alzheimer disease'. Disease is not broadcast onto WT rows.

Methods: 'The 5xFAD transgenic mice ... were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory (stock #034848)'; MMRRC catalog record 034848 gives this strain designation. WT rows (littermates / SILAM / plaque WT) stay not available: no source names their background.

'Sample ID' column of sheet 'Protein turnover' (the SILAM reference, listed once per batch, is written SILAM_B1/SILAM_B2 so that each run's rows share one technical replicate); Supplementary Data 2 lists the same 30 mice with identical batch/channel (B1_127N ... B2_134N).
Methods: 'Cortical brain tissue samples were harvested for turnover analysis'; Supp Data 23: 'collected from cortical brain tissue'. UBERON:0000956.
Sheet 'Sex' column M/F; Methods: 'Only male mice were used in turnover analysis'; the fully labelled SILAM reference is F.
Sheet 'Protein turnover' column 'Age (mo)': 9 for all 30 mice, 8 for SILAM; Supp Data 2: '~9' months. Format {Number}M per SAMPLE-GUIDELINES.
'Labeling days' column (0, 4, 8, 16, 32) = days on Lys-13C6 SILAC diet; SILAM is 'inf' (fully labelled over two generations), so not applicable.
Labelling time is the second ANOVA variable (Methods: 'labeling time (4, 8, 16, and 32 d)').

claims.evidence: pepXML search_summary: K +304.2071453 variable=N; n-terminus +304.2071453 variable=N (peptide, protein_terminus=N); M +15.99492 variable=Y; K +6.02013 variable=Y. No Cys modification declared. UNIMOD:2016 TMTpro, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:188 Label:13C(6) (Lys-13C6 diet, Methods) verified in OLS.

Kept after review 1 (minor): general Methods say DTT/IAA for mouse brain samples, but the turnover search declares no Cys carbamidomethylation (database '..._c0_TMTpro') and Methods add Carbamidomethyl only 'if the residue was alkylated'; reduction/alkylation of these samples is therefore unresolved.
As for reduction reagent: conflicting evidence on alkylation for the turnover samples.
PRIDE data processing protocol: 6 ppm precursor / 15 ppm fragment; paper Methods: 10 ppm both. Conflict -> not available.
See precursor mass tolerance.

limitations: Mass tolerances conflict (paper 10 ppm vs PRIDE 6 ppm precursor / 15 ppm fragment); written as not available.
WT strain background not stated (littermates, SILAM line, plaque WT); strain or breed = not available on WT rows. 5xFAD rows use the MMRRC 034848 designation.

characteristics[age] is not listed in the contract of ms-proteomics@1.1.0 + vertebrates@1.1.0 + clinical-metadata@1.0.0 (it is a human-template column); it is added per sample from the sheet at the coordinator's request after review 1, and parse_sdrf validates it (exit 0).
Reconcile flags plaque runs as 'carotid artery' from the token 'plaque' - a keyword false positive (amyloid plaques LCM from brain, Methods).

PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx types the SILAM row opening the batch-2 block as Batch=1; it was assigned to batch 2 (mtob2, TMT126) by its block position, since batch 2 otherwise has no TMT126 sample. Supplementary Data 2 does not list SILAM.

SILAM (fully 13C6-Lys labelled female WT reference, 8 mo) is listed with the same Sample ID in both batches; written as two source names SILAM_B1/SILAM_B2 (one per batch) because sdrf-tools structure rejects mixed technical replicates within one run. Whether it is one lysate is not stated.

Reduction/alkylation for turnover samples unresolved: general Methods say DTT/IAA, but the deposited turnover search has no Cys modification; reagents written as not available, no Carbamidomethyl asserted (search wins).

The pulsed SILAC state is not a comment[label] channel here (each TMT channel holds both light and heavy Lys peptides); it is represented by Label:13C(6) K variable modification and characteristics[exposure duration].
parse_sdrf validate-sdrf was run with --use_ols_cache_only (online ontology lookups hung on the shared host); ontology terms were verified separately live via OLS (sdrf-tools verify/ols).

parse_sdrf convert-openms fails ('Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available'): the JUMP pepXML records no tolerances and paper vs PRIDE disagree, so the sentinel is kept and the file is not OpenMS-convertible as is.
